title: Design System: Console Task Orchestrator — Version B

display.purpose: Doto accent on shared estimated cost; not task prose.

headline.purpose: Orient the task; compact mobile is 15px.

title.purpose: Desktop owner panel; redundant mobile heading is hidden.

body.purpose: Readable task guidance and orchestrator prose.

label.purpose: Mono speaker, source and usage metadata.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Enabled on button active state only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

extensions.layoutNotes: The first three breakpoints are max-width container queries on the app window. Review chrome is a max-width viewport query; compact height is a max-height viewport query. Shared overview also has 1100px and 900px container rules.
extensions.depthNotes: No drop-shadow vocabulary. Native dialog backdrop is #0009; the drawer uses an overlay stacking level and muted edge.
extensions.colorRampNotes: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH inspection metadata, not additional shipped CSS palette tokens.

components.name: Ink action
components.description: Strong neutral action, including the composer Send control.

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Secondary or utility action with visible border and focus.

components.name: Task state
components.description: Readable state paired with the recurring square cell.

components.name: Current project task
components.description: A selected task in the project navigator with source metadata.

components.name: Orchestrator composer
components.description: The sole task recipient, with the compact textarea and adjacent Send action.
components.html: <form class="ds-composer"><label class="ds-recipient" for="ds-guidance">To: T-031 orchestrator</label><textarea id="ds-guidance" class="ds-field" aria-label="Guidance to task orchestrator"></textarea><button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-send">Send</button></form>

components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:600 11px/1.5 var(--ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif);min-height:28px;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#26292d);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#ebe8e1)}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--raise,#1a1c1f);border-color:var(--mut,#9a9993)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#ebe8e1);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default}.ds-decision{padding:11px 18px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#26292d);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#26292d);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--you,#ff8a3d) 4%,var(--win,#121315));color:var(--ink,#ebe8e1);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px 18px;align-items:center}.ds-decision-tag{grid-column:1/-1;font:10px/1.5 var(--mono,"Cascadia Mono",monospace);color:var(--you,#ff8a3d)}.ds-decision-title{font:500 13px/1.5 var(--ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif);margin:0}.ds-decision-copy{font:11px/1.6 var(--ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif);color:var(--mut,#9a9993);margin:3px 0 0}.ds-decision-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}

narrative.overview:
A dense operator workspace uses quiet surfaces, thin rules and small square cells to keep task identity, conversation, evidence and decisions distinct. The project navigator and persistent decision dock extend the existing task workspace. Reading type stays ordinary; Doto gives shared usage figures their established instrument-like accent.

This document describes the finished local Version B artifact, not the production application or a new global product identity. Its authority is the implemented source plus the local surface brief; product constraints remain in CLAUDE.md, plans/62-task-orchestrators.md and its 03-mockup-contract.md. All sample tasks and measurements are fictional.
keyCharacteristics: Dark and light themes share the same semantic surface and status roles.
Conversation and evidence scroll independently; the decision and action dock stays outside those scroll regions.
One task has one assigned orchestrator and one composer recipient.
Small cells, mono measurements and restrained Doto figures carry the Console identity.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Theme changes replace each role in place; preserve the role rather than copying a dark-theme color into a new component.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Keep Doto on the established usage accent and ancillary page display; task prose and task headings use the UI stack.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use surface role and border changes for workbench depth; keep the transcript and evidence flat.

dos: Do preserve one composer addressed to the assigned task orchestrator.
Do keep current decisions accessible while switching evidence views.
Do pair status color with readable state text and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do use the adjacent shared assets and local B overrides together when reviewing this variant.
donts: Don't infer acceptance from worker exit or replace current verification with stale evidence.
Don't enable a worker route without proven availability.
Don't present simulated receipts, files, estimates or utility previews as live runtime results.
Don't treat this local artifact or the two resolved review findings as production approval.
